notes.title: New Rules: More Points Win
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for purchasing 'War of Cards: ROMA'. As mentioned in the title, the game has just been updated to version 0.5.12

In this update, we will introduce a new game rules to everyone: "More Points Win". When creating a game, you can choose this mode and then select the limited number of rounds. Taking 30 rounds as an example, After the end of the 30th round, the player with the highest score wins. The scoring method is shown in the following diagram:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760747/edb5092f1dc59f4b29f84d33c6097d32e39910ff.png[/img]

If two players have exactly the same score, the game will be extended by one turn.

In addition, many players have complained before that they cannot find the button to add AI. So, in the new version, we have added a text prompt for "Join AI Player" at the button position.

The above is the introduction of the new version. We hope to see everyone's comments and opinions on Steam as a reference for us to improve the game in the future.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Timed Deathmatch mode, bringing new challenges and strategic choices
notes.content:
hello everyone! Thank you for your purchase. 

The Wars of Cards: ROMA is a small game produced by our amateur team. It is an honor for you to spend your time and money to experience this game. Currently, over 150 sets of this game have been sold. We will strive to update and live up to the expectations of buyers. At the same time, we also hope that everyone can write down their comments and opinions.

Last week, we completed the first version update for after-sales service, adding a new card. This week we will introduce a new game mode to everyone: "Timed Deathmatch". When creating a game, you can choose this mode and then select the limited number of rounds to complete it. For example, in a 30 round Timed Deathmatch, if the game has not been determined after 30 rounds, the game will be forced to end. Please feel free to experience the specific situation yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760747/404cd08718a994f3824c80932c384c822098bb24.png[/img]

The Timed Deathmatch will prevent players from engaging in endless and prolonged battles. The most advantageous player on the field must end the war as soon as possible before the turn deadline arrives. And weaker players can adopt delaying tactics to fight for the possibility of a draw. Even, taking advantage of the opponent's eagerness to win, create opportunities for counterattack.

The new version 0.5.9 also made some other minor changes. You can try to find it in the game. If you like this game, I would like to leave a comment on Steam and recommend it to your friends. Finally, we hope everyone has a pleasant time!

notes.title: Slaves will be armed! 0.5.8 version update
notes.content:
hello everyone! Thank you all for your patronage. This game has sold over 130 sets in three weeks. To thank everyone for their support, we have conducted the first version update to add game content. In version 0.5.8, a brand new card was added to the game and some card values were adjusted. Please refer to the following for detailed updates:

1. Add a new Card - [SERVI ARMATI] (Armed Slave)
This card represents a squad of armed slaves. In emergency situations, slaves can also be armed and sent into battle. They lack experience, equipment, and fighting spirit, but it’s better than having nothing.

This card is a 'unit card', but it has two special skills: It returns to your hand after a victorious battle. The card is not affected by the Chief High Priest and Vestal.

PS: Although the combat power of armed slaves is very weak, their two skills will bring a new change to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760747/830fea74d07a88222c4b893333cc2a81e2101b65.png[/img]

2. Card value adjustment. Specifically, it includes:
ELEPHANTI BELLI（War Elephants）: AP and DP reduced from 30 to 25
LEGATUS: AP and DP reduced from 1 to 0
MURI LIGNEI（Wooden Walls）: DP changed from +5 to +6
BUCINATOR（Trumpeter）: AP changed from +5 to +6

3. Improve some minor deficiencies in the UI.

The above is the main update content. If you like this game, we would like to leave your comment on Steam and recommend it to your friends. Finally, we hope everyone has a pleasant time!
